purpose: Report a reason or piece of information without firm verification.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + とかで; plain clause + とか
The bus took a detour because, apparently, there was work on the bridge.
My sister is not coming today because she apparently has exams soon.
I hear that shop is moving next month.
formation: Plain clause + とかで; plain clause + とか
restrictions: とかで often gives a vaguely recalled reported reason.
mistake: Do not use vague hearsay where verified information is required.
